finalText:
Fixed. 5/5 pass.

`token.js:7` — `isExpired` used `token.exp < nowSeconds`. Token with `exp` exactly equal to now returned `false` = valid, so token slipped through for one second past expiry. Doc comment say "expired the moment `exp` is reached" — strict `<` contradict it.

```js
return token.exp <= nowSeconds;
```

`secondsLeft` needed no change — it delegate to `isExpired`, so boundary now return 0.

Note on running: `node --test tests/` fail on this Node (v22.22.2) with `MODULE_NOT_FOUND` — directory arg not resolved. Use `node --test tests/token.test.js` or `node --test` from repo root.
